claim.claim-text: 1. Process for the preparation of the solid form of the compound of formula I

comprising that the purified oily compound of formula I is dissolved in the same amount of polar solvent as the mass of the oily product, and such an amount of alkane is added to it that the solution turns opalescent, the solution is then solidified glassy at a temperature from -60°C to -20°C and the solvent is removed in high vacuum.
2. Process according to claim 1 wherein the polar solvent is acetone, ethyl acetate, methyl ethyl ketone or isopropanol.
3. Process according to claim 1 or 2 wherein the alkane is pentane, n-hexane, cyclohexane or heptane.
5. Solid phase iloprost in the form of amorphous powder.
7. Iloprost having a purity of at least 98.5 mass% in the form of crystal.
